title: ZAINAB LIPAT GAY! HAI MAZAARE HUSSAIN SE
body:
Armaan hai ye Zainab-e Aali Maqaam ka
Chehlum hai Karbala me Shahe Tashnakaam ka
Bhai ki Qabr dekhke aansu nikal pade
Pyaason ki yaad aayi to dariya ubal pade
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya Tumhare baad anokhe sitam huwe
Durre lage ridaae'n chhini khaime jal gaye
Bano ke Qalb ka wo sahara bhi jal gaya
Maa dekhti hee reh gayi jhula bhi jal gaya
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya wo raat kaisi qayamat ki raat thi
Ahle Haram pa sakht musibat ki raat thi
Shaane kata ke MeraNigehbaan so gaya
Abbas ka jo farz tha Main ne ada kiya
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Khwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaghaz Karbala se Hamara safar hua
Abid ko dekh dekh ke tukde jigar huwa
Kufe me Sar barehna jo Aale Aba gaye
Baba har ek qadam pa Mujhe yaad Aagaye
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya phir uske baad qayamat hi aagayi
Kunbe ko leke Shaam me Main berida gayi
Taabe nazar kaha'n thi magar dekhna pada
Tashte tila me Aap ka Sar dekhna pada
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya Tumhari Beti pa kya kya sitam huwa
Lekin kabhi na sabr ka meyaar kam huwa
Jab inteha-e zulme sitamgaar hogayi
Aakhir Sakina Shaam ke zinda'n me Sogayi
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehlum ke baad Main jo Madine ko Jaaungi
Amma ko Main safar ki musibat Sunaungi
Gar hosake to neel rasan ke Dikhaungi
Main zindagi tamaam Tera Gham Manaungi
<<MINI>>
Bhai ki Qabr hil gayi Knwahar ke bain se
Zainab Lipat Gayi hai Mazaare Hussain se
author: Akhtar Zaidi
